summary: Reproduced the independent review's remaining counterexample at candidate commit 75e10e4bdbfdfa2f05a5b5258eda2bb48cb3db02: a health probe received by a fully idle scheduler entered ordinary request admission and changed modeled waiting-queue length, attempted prefill batch size, PrefillDelayer outcome accounting, and per-rank prefill progress before the next user request. Preserved the candidate's valid controller-side isolation and additionally diverted all generation health probes before scheduler admission. Busy probes retain the existing next-result health signal; idle probes receive that signal immediately.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before at the exact candidate behavior: 2 failures showed the fully idle health request reached _request_dispatcher; in the interleaving it was admitted before the user request. The admission recorder tracks waiting_queue, attempted_prefill_batch_sizes, prefill_delayer_outcomes, and prefill_progress. Raw output: reports/j-877aea8d47d5/raw/pytest-candidate-failing.txt

28 tests passed. Health probes leave the scheduler admission recorder's waiting queue, attempted prefill size, delayer outcomes, and local prefill progress unchanged; the following user has the same single admission. Busy probes remain deferred until the next result. Candidate controller invariants for user routing counters and budgets also remain covered. Raw output: reports/j-877aea8d47d5/raw/pytest-focused-passing.txt
All applicable formatting, lint, repository-policy, and registered-test validation hooks passed. Raw output: reports/j-877aea8d47d5/raw/pre-commit.txt

gpu_execution_evidence: No GPU execution was used as evidence for this scheduler-only correction.
remaining_limitations: The assigned environment does not provide the reported eight NVIDIA B30Z topology or DeepSeek-V4-Pro weights, so TP8/DP8 throughput, one-chunk rank divergence, mixed/delay persistence, and running-request collapse were not rerun.
The deterministic regression establishes and removes the scheduler-side state perturbation identified by review; it does not claim numerical reproduction of the reported 62-79k tok/s regime.
Health generation now verifies scheduler responsiveness without admitting a one-token model forward. Busy probes already used this lightweight response behavior before this correction.
No native C++ or FlyDSL source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
